sources.title: ReCAAP ISC Annual Report on Piracy and Armed Robbery against Ships in Asia 2023
sources.text: While underway, the Malaysian Marine Police patrol boat spotted two boats moored to the barge. Several men were sighted on top of the scrap metal pile on the barge. Upon seeing the patrol boat, the perpetrators immediately escaped in their boats, which crashed into the side of the patrol boat. All perpetrators were arrested and their boats with an estimated 100 ton of scrap metal were seized. [Shipping company]
